name: clone-any-site-scripts
description: Bundled tooling for the clone-any-site skill: crawler (zero-dep), loopback server (zero-dep), and the Playwright fidelity gate.
comment: Minimum Node 18 (built-in fetch); Node 20 LTS recommended (see .nvmrc). crawl.mjs + serve.mjs need only Node built-ins. run-fidelity.mjs + extract-manifest.mjs + publish-gate.mjs need the devDependencies above + `npx playwright install chromium`. fit-slot.mjs uses optional sharp (images) + the ffmpeg binary on PATH (video); run `node clone-deps-check.mjs` to verify — both degrade gracefully if absent.
